prompt: Create a premium, modern e-commerce storefront for a contemporary lifestyle and fashion brand. It should have a distinctive visual identity, refined typography, a responsive navigation bar, a strong hero section, product categories, an attractive product grid, product cards, functional product filtering, a shopping cart drawer, quantity controls, subtotal and total calculations, and a polished footer. Use a cohesive design system, thoughtful spacing, high-quality imagery, subtle animations, and a professional responsive layout. All visible interactions must work.

designSpec.purpose: A premium, modern e-commerce storefront for a contemporary lifestyle and fashion brand featuring immersive product discovery, interactive filtering, and seamless cart management.
designSpec.targetAudience: Style-conscious modern consumers, design enthusiasts, and urban professionals seeking high-end contemporary apparel and lifestyle objects.
designSpec.visualDirection: High-touch editorial luxury with razor-sharp modern minimalism, generous whitespace, high-contrast typography, and a refined neutral palette punctuated by a striking accent.

heading.usage: Hero titles, primary section headers, major price points

body.usage: Product descriptions, navigation items, body text, UI controls

mono.usage: SKU codes, stock indicators, and cart item calculations

layout.structure: Editorial grid layout with full-bleed hero banners, sticky category navigation, responsive multi-column product grids, and slide-over cart drawer.

navigation.details: Sticky glassmorphic top navigation bar featuring brand wordmark, category links, search trigger, wishlist counter, and interactive cart drawer toggle with real-time item badge.

hero.headline: Form, Function & Future Heritage
hero.subheadline: Explore our Autumn/Winter curation of uncompromising contemporary apparel and artisanal objects designed for the modern interior and exterior.
hero.details: High-impact split layout featuring high-fashion editorial imagery on one side and bold typograhic hierarchy with direct categorical entry points on the other.

mediaDirection.description: Monochromatic and warm-toned lifestyle photography with dramatic natural lighting, architectural backdrops, and clean studio product shots on neutral grounds.
mediaDirection.imageTreatment: Subtle zoom effect on hover with crisp 4:5 aspect ratios for product galleries and 16:9 for hero showcases.
mediaDirection.iconStyle: Minimalist stroke icons with 1.5px weight for UI controls, arrows, and shopping bags.

motion.strategy: Smooth, restrained micro-interactions with 200ms ease-out transitions for cart drawers, tab switching, and image zooms.

responsive.mobileStrategy: Single-column product feed with horizontal scroll category chips, collapsible filter drawers, and full-screen mobile cart overlay.

accessibility.contrastRatio: WCAG AAA compliant dark text (#111111) on warm paper background (#fcfbf7).

designSpec.signature: Sticky drawer cart pill with instant item count badge updates and seamless live subtotal calculations.

filesPlanned.description: Global CSS with Google Fonts import (Syne & Plus Jakarta Sans), Tailwind imports, root variables for DesignSpec palette (#fcfbf7 bg, #111111 text, #1a1a1a accent), and custom keyframe animations.
Sticky navigation header with brand logo, category links, search trigger, wishlist indicator, and interactive cart drawer trigger with item badge.
Split composition hero section featuring high-fashion lifestyle photography, bold Syne display typography, and immediate call-to-action buttons.
Interactive category showcase allowing users to filter products by curated collections (All, Apparel, Footwear, Accessories, Objects).
Individual product card with image hover states, quick add-to-cart button, price display, and wishlist toggle.
Responsive multi-column product grid with search query filtering, category filtering, and sorting options.
Slide-over shopping cart drawer with quantity increments/decrements, item removal, live subtotal, shipping progress bar, and checkout CTA.
Polished footer with newsletter subscription form, brand manifesto, helpful links, and copyright info.
Main application root uniting state management for cart items, active category filters, search keywords, wishlist, and assembling all modular components.

designSpec.purpose: A premium, modern e-commerce storefront for a contemporary lifestyle and fashion brand offering apparel, accessories, and home objects.
designSpec.targetAudience: Design-conscious consumers, urban professionals, and lifestyle enthusiasts who appreciate minimalist luxury, sustainable fabrics, and timeless aesthetics.
designSpec.visualDirection: High-end editorial aesthetic with generous whitespace, crisp grid structures, delicate borders, and immersive product photography.

heading.usage: Brand logo, hero headers, section titles, and key numeric callouts.

body.usage: Product descriptions, navigation items, filtering controls, and body copy.

mono.usage: SKU numbers, order identifiers, and price tags.

navigation.details: Fixed top navigation with brand logo centered or left-aligned, category links, search trigger, wishlist counter, and animated shopping bag pill showing live item count.

hero.headline: Form, Fabric, and Function.
hero.subheadline: Explore the Autumn/Winter collection crafted from organic fibers and uncompromising tailoring.
hero.details: Asymmetric editorial split screen featuring high-resolution lifestyle imagery on the right and typographic emphasis with quick category jump links on the left.

mediaDirection.description: Studio and outdoor editorial lookbooks featuring neutral earth tones, dramatic natural lighting, and sharp macro textures of woven fabrics.
mediaDirection.imageTreatment: Clean rectangles with subtle zoom on hover and quick-add overlay buttons.
mediaDirection.iconStyle: Minimalist stroke icons (lucide-react) with 1.5px stroke width.

motion.strategy: Smooth, restrained micro-interactions including fade-in page transitions, slide-over drawer animations, and seamless image swaps on card hover.

Contemporary newsletter subscription banner with first-order discount perk, instant form validation, and feedback state.
